name: Gaussian Rasterization via OpenGL Interop
definition: A technique to rasterize 3D Gaussians by uploading sorted Gaussian attributes to an OpenGL Vertex Buffer Object (VBO) via CUDA-GL interop, rendering them as points using a custom GLSL program, and reading the resulting framebuffer back to CUDA memory.
summary: Gaussian Rasterization via OpenGL Interop rasterizes 3D Gaussians by leveraging OpenGL's fixed-function pipeline via CUDA-OpenGL interop, offloading fragment processing to the GPU driver instead of using custom CUDA kernels.
